verdict.rationale: Skyfire says its tokens conform to "the open KYAPay protocol, an industry specification... (KYAPay.org)" (skyfire-supp-3), suggesting a public spec exists, but the same evidence notes that charging, wallets, and settlement all run through Skyfire's own proprietary APIs requiring API keys and dashboard signup (skyfire-docs-1, skyfire-supp-8). A probe for a versioned OpenAPI/spec file returned 404s across all standard locations (skyfire-probe-2), and no evidence shows a standalone, versioned spec document readable/implementable independent of Skyfire's platform. missing for 10: a directly linked, versioned KYAPay spec document, evidence it can be implemented by a third party without any Skyfire account/API key, and confirmation the spec covers the full commerce flow (not just token format).
